reviews.text: I took my senior dog in at my 8am appt to be euthanized due to her being very sick and no longer responsive. The staff were terrific they were kind and gentle and made us feel very at ease. I appreciate the staff so much in this difficult time. We were told the cost up from when we made the appt and that was the true amount. I would recommend Sploot as they were wonderful to us.

I had a great experience at this clinic! As a new cat owner with a former street cat of unknown history, I really appreciated how helpful the doctor was in answering all of my questions. We did a nail trim, deworming, vaccines, and a few other things. My cat felt very comfortable with the staff; everyone was kind and knew exactly how to engage with her. Parking was super convenient, and they were understanding even though I was running late. I would definitely recommend Dr. Isabelle Dohanics and her staff to friends and family!
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Taylor! We’re so happy you had a great experience with our vet care team 💛 …

I am such an emotional person and when it came to my baby Mateo getting his dental surgery done, the team at sploot was so Exceptional, not only did they communicate everything every step of the way and kept my baby calm and comfortable they did the same for me, personal calls from Dr. Cruz her self to explain everything and calm my nerves 10/10 experience the team and Dr. Cruz was so amazing every step of the way, so glad i found a vet that cares about our furry family. Thank you so much from Mateo and I Sploot Lincoln Park!

I was referred out here from the Oak Park location for my cat's ultrasound (since they only so abdominal ultrasounds at the Chicago locations). We arrived 15 minutes early, and after checking in, we waited over an hour for services; there was no communication on why the wait was so long. I'm fairly sure I could hear the techs talking about "how far Oak Park is" in the back while we waited. I'm not sure I'll be continuing services at Sploot after this experience, since it seems like I should pick somewhere more local.

General info: quoted ~$350 for the ultrasound before insurance. Visit itself is an additional $99.

False advertising pricing & atrocious customer service. My husband called and let them know he’s stuck in traffic (4:15 appt) spoke to the guy at the desk. He got there at 4:26 and the guy said “sorry you’re late, can’t see you..we have a 10 minute grace period and it’s been 11 MINUTES.” Mind you, this was after we already visited once and were lied to about pricing, which prompted us to reach out to corporate to honor the listing. Seems like you don’t want to do that. Stay far away from this place they do not care about your pet. I wouldn’t trust my dog with them EVER. Beyond disappointed

This was my first time using Sploot for my Dog.  🐶 must say I had a wonderful and extremely great experience from making the appointment on the phone as well as checking in.  The staff was very pleasant and engaged with my Chandler.  My Chandler has anxieties especially coming to the vet.  Our vet tech and vet were very patient, cared about my Chandler and extremely thorough.  Both my husband and I were extremely satisfied and will be returning for other urgent care needs.  The entire visit was affordable.  Thank you Sploot!
Thank you for the amazing 5-star review, Baraa! We’re always happy to provide next-level veterinary care.🤗 …

FALSE ADVERTISING & HIDDEN FEES! Avoid at all costs! We went out of our way to come here and were quoted double (over $2000) the screenshotted advertised price ($750) for a standard dental cleaning, no one on staff could explain why their website was inaccurate and misleading. LOTS OF HIDDEN FEES.

so far ive been twice, the first time they insisted on a surgery that was not needed, ive recently brought my dog back and it just turns into a game of how much do you care about your dog vs how much we can guilt you into paying for un-needed tests. sure the staff is nice, but i want my dogs to take priority.
Sploot is a great place for pet owners and their pets. They are responsive, knowledgeable and everyone cares about your pet and their wellbeing. Dr. Choca and Indigo S. are fantastic!

This was my first time visiting with my newly adopted kitten, who I was very worried about and wanted to have seen asap. From the time they answered my call, they were very helpful. I appreciated that they asked questions about my kitten’s condition over the phone and documented everything. It showed me they were taking my concerns seriously and as a new pet owner, that meant a lot.

Thankfully they had a same day appt. The staff at the clinic were friendly and super helpful as well

Terrible customer service! If I could give this place zero stars I would.  I made an appt for cytopoint at 5:15pm and the lady booking my appt aggressively told me that I was the last appt of the day and if I was late, I would need to reschedule. In order to ensure I was on time I left work early And arrived a little after 5!  It is now 6:40 and we have not been seen yet. The guy at the front desk told me to reschedule if I no longer wanted to wait.  Are you kidding me.This place is ridiculously unprofessional and has zero management in place to see that things run smoothly.

We got the best care for our dog during his annual wellness visit at Sploot. Everyone made us feel right at home and really listened. I appreciate that they provide different options for keeping the vet bill reasonable :)
Indigo S. helped my dog feel comfortable during a painful ear infection. She treated our dog kindly and sent us home with a much happier dog. Thank you for the great care!
I was taken care of quickly with attention to detail. Everyone was caring and understanding.

This was our first time at Sploot and we had an amazing experience from start to finish. We took our 3 month old kitten in for his second Vaccine and were nervous at first because this was a last minute decision on where to take him. Our usual vet was booked with no appointments available. The person at the front desk greeted us kindly and got us checked in and settled in a room right away! Both ladies that checked on our kitten were really nice to both us and our kitten! Dr. Dohanics was patient with all of our questions and gave us clear answers for everything we wanted to know! The cost was a bit pricier than I’ve paid in the past but I’d say it was worth it. Got to feel more involved with my kittens care being in a closed room discussing whats being done compared to places where you speak to the doctor by the front desk and they take your cat to the back while you wait. Would recommend and will definitely be back again!
I always appreciate their thoroughness, genuine care, transparency, and willingness to answer my questions.
I love the staff at sploot, they are all polite, friendly and have good energy you and your fur babies. They made sure to take care of my kitten with a broken toe.
Indigo S. was so great and helpful :) she and the entire team made my pup feels so loved and special during her appointment
Indigo was wonderful with my dog, Scout. We had a great experience!

I brought my senior kitty here for an urgent issue, and the entire team was wonderful. They were able to get me in right away due to a cancellation, which I truly appreciated.

Everyone took the time to explain everything thoroughly, and the veterinarian also pointed out a few things unrelated to the primary issue that I should discuss with my regular vet. Most importantly, my boy was calm and comfortable when we left and after we got home, which reassured me that he was treated with kindness throughout his procedure.
No bad experiences coming here. Friendly staff. Helped my GSD with her diarrhea.
We had a wonderful experience! They made our dog Mario feel at ease and everyone was so nice!  I highly recommend!

We brought my 10 year old cat in for limping. We were seen by Dr Choca and Kate. They were both very kind, comforting, and thorough. My cat was obviously very scared, but Dr Choca and Kate were understanding and patient with her (and us lol). I have always been nervous about taking my cat in for vet visits because of how scary it can be but I feel comfortable about returning to this Sploot location in the future.

Five stars in every respect. Modern very clean facility, conveniently located, easy parking, excellent friendly responsive reception, no waiting, comfortable examination room, warm friendly knowledgeable veterinarian, thorough and efficient examination, very fair price, exceptional value.
I had a negative experience with the rudeness & I am not fond of this subscription model.  They charged me upon the entire appointment fee upon scheduling the appointment.

I brought my cat Stella because she was not feeling well and I could not figure the problem, when I brought her to Sploot everyone was very welcoming and nice and also took care of Stella very well. She is doing great now thank you!
Issa H was great. He definitely went above and beyond for my henny! We look forward to seeing him again.

Great experience from start to finish! The staff was friendly, caring, and professional, and the veterinarian took the time to thoroughly explain everything and answer my questions. Bailey received excellent care, and I felt completely confident in the treatment provided. Highly recommend!

Very friendly and helpful staff. Big shout out to nurse Ruby for being great with my boy and helping him feel comfortable! I was able to make a same day (weekend) appointment, highly recommend if you need vet in the area.
Website says 8pm but closed at 6pm
Very friendly and professional
Smooth free wellness exam! Highly recommended! Patient and supportive staff.

Sploot was professional  and very helpful in making our visit their only focus and priority..I expect our follow up visit to be as good.
.The only error was I forgot to ask what               Sploot means.

Great location got the dog in quickly for an urgent situation.  Dr Ricon was terrific, she diagnosed an underlying condition in addition to what we came in for. So greatful 💖.  Staff was very friendly and accommodating.

I took my dog Oreo in last weekend for x rays and diagnosis on what was causing him to vomit more than 24 hours. They did x rays, vet called us and could not confidently tell us if it was an obstruction. They needed a second opinion (fine, another $150) from a radiologist who then also could not come to a conclusion. Their solution? More money for a different test to determine the obstruction. $1k spent later, I ended up taking my dog to the ER where I received a clear x ray and diagnosis. Save your money from here if you need x rays. The only thing I will say is staff was very kind, this has nothing to do with customer service. The paper copy is the ER’s x ray pointing to the issue and the other x ray is sploots.

Thought this was a great experience. Then I looked at my invoice.
I brought my cat in for a pre-neutering routine wellness checkup. That was the only reason for the visit. When I got the invoice, they had it categorized as a sick visit instead of a wellness visit. For anyone with pet insurance, you already know what that means. Sick visits aren't covered under wellness plans, so I'm not getting reimbursed.
I called to ask why. The answer was that I had made an offhand comment during the visit that my cat sometimes walks with a little limp. It was a casual side comment, the kind of thing you'd say to a friend, basically "yeah he kind of limps sometimes, probably stepped on something, no big deal."
Here's the kicker. Their own notes say there was nothing wrong with him and that he didn't have a limp at the visit. So they used a passing comment about something they themselves confirmed wasn't an issue to bump my visit from wellness to sick. Which conveniently made it the kind of visit my insurance won't cover.
I'm out $119 because of how they chose to label it, and they've told me there's nothing they're willing to do about it.
If you bring your pet here, be careful what you say in passing. Apparently a casual comment is all it takes to change your bill and make sure your insurance won't help you.

This is only based on the customer service I received on the phone - I did not get to make an appointment or experience the medical service at this location.

5pm on Sunday, I decided to have my dog seen by a vet as she developed unknown pain badly since the morning. Couldn’t see her in pain anymore, so googled “urgent pet care” then called this location out of desperation.

Got connected to a receptionist, who was probably worse than an Ai tool in answering. Shortly after my brief description of situation, I got “we are appointment based only” (okay got that), my 2nd question on any recommended ERs that they can refer, the answer “any 24 hour urgency care would do.”

I’m not asking for a shoulder to cry on here. But three word answers in a cold tone are not something you’d expect from a human, especially a veterinary care reception when you’re desperate and seeking help. AI tools probably would be more sympathetic. All worked out in the end and my dog got helped at an ER not from here. But if you’re looking to take your healthy dog for a check up and some pet pet… maybe!
We recently switched vets and have been so so pleased with sploot Lincoln park. All of our concerns are addressed with the upmost respect and everyone is so sweet to our pup. We love Dr Weinburg!

My cat had started showing signs of missing fur in little patches and I became worried and called Sploot. A simple Google search showed me 4.8 average stars on almost 300 reviews; that is pretty impressive.

I was greeted warmly, shown to a room, and met with first the tech and then the vet. Amongst all 4 staff members, I can truly say I was treated well, heard, questions were answered, and not once did anyone say anything negative towards me.

My cat is usually pretty chill at the vet and this experience was no difference. The vet sat on the floor with her and my cat did well, as you can see with her curled up on the scale.

Highly recommend. They were upfront with prices which was great for budgeting and accept Care credit card which is also helpful.

Dear Michael,

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. If there’s anything specific you’d like to share about your experience, we’d love to hear your feedback. Please feel free to reach out to us at bizops@splootvets.com so we can assist you further.

Your input is important to us, and we’re always looking for ways to improve!

Dear Conner,

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. If there’s anything specific you’d like to share about your experience, we’d love to hear your feedback. Please feel free to reach out to us at bizops@splootvets.com so we can assist you further.

Your input is important to us, and we’re always looking for ways to improve!
This veterinary clinic is amazing. Nice and friendly staff. My cat enjoyed himself as well

I brought my dog, Dewey, to Sploot Animal Vet on Sunday, 4/25/26, for a 1:45 p.m. appointment. Since I had some extra time, I arrived early around 1:15 p.m. While I was on my way, the front desk called to ask a few standard follow-up questions, which I appreciated. However, when I arrived, no one was at the front desk and I ended up waiting about 10 minutes before anyone came out. I even tried opening and closing the door a few times to get someone’s attention.

The receptionist seemed a bit confused during the check-in process. Overall, the staff was friendly and nice, so I don’t have complaints there. The veterinarian suggested some expensive testing that I didn’t feel was necessary at the time, though she was not pushy. I did agree to blood work just to get some reassurance, knowing I would likely seek a second opinion.

I was told the vet would call by midweek with the lab results, but by Wednesday afternoon I still hadn’t heard anything, so I called for an update. I was told the results were in and were just waiting on the doctor, but by 8 p.m. that night, when the office closed, I still had not received a call. Since I had another appointment scheduled with my local vet on Friday, I asked for all paperwork to be sent there, which was done.

Overall, I was not impressed with the high cost of the visit or the lack of follow-up from the staff. Unfortunately, this felt more like a big chain focused on money than care. I would personally recommend looking for a local vet instead, and I would not go back.

We had an urgent situation with our dog and walked into Sploot and they were able to get us in immediately as new clients which was greatly appreciated. Their staff was very caring and helpful and immediately knew what the issue was and how to resolve it. They even followed up the next day to check to make sure our dog was recovering well. We felt very cared for; they do a great job!
Very patient and knowledgeable
Dr Korput was amazing with Macie. The vet techs were just as awesome. I’m very happy with my experience at the Lincoln park location and will be returning for routine care :)

The staff were very kind and attentive. They provided care options without pressure to run multiple tests, scans, etc. right away. I will definitely return! They are so transparent on their pricing on the website and during the appointment which is wonderful.
Dr Korput and Carla did a fabulous job helping us with our new puppy. They were knowledgeable, thorough and kind. Highly recommend!
If it’s urgent or an emergency just go to Med Vet or VEG. Sploot is neither faster nor less expensive than the emergency vets in the area.
Clean vet and the staff was very nice and helpful. My dog is scared of the vet and they made him feel very safe. Will definitely come back!
Sweet, Kind, Fair Pricing
First rate service. Highly recommend Sploot. Every appointment has been excellent.

I cannot speak highly enough about their kindness toward a pet they had never met. We lost our little pet very unexpectedly, and the wonderful person who answered the phone assured me they could take care of all the aftercare needs. They were able to get me in within 15 minutes of my call.

We chose to have paw prints made in plaster, which was such a thoughtful service. The prints were delivered in a beautiful box, packed securely with care, along with a pamphlet on grief. However, it was receiving the sympathy card in the mail which was personally written by several staff members and the doctor that left me speechless. We all teared up reading their kind notes of empathy and seeing the sweet paw prints.

I genuinely hope that Sploot’s C-suite never interferes with this office or pushes them to prioritize business in a way that compromises the genuine human connection they demonstrated with such grace. Paws off, the individuals at the Clybourn office are fantastic people who are doing an excellent job. Thank you again.

We came in for an urgent care appointment today because our vet is closed on weekends. We had a great experience working with Indigo, she was thorough with her questions and notes to share with the doctor. Dr. Than was very informative. She gave multiple options for how to proceed and was very patient in answering ALL of my questions (and I had several!). Even though we were the last appointment of the day and I’m sure they were both ready to go home, I never felt like they were trying to rush us out.
I also really appreciated the transparent pricing. When I called for the appointment they were able to tell me the initial exam fee and in the appointment they were clear about what the costs would be for various treatment options.
From Kenny to Kate to Holly on the phone to Dr W and Geoff , they made a horrible day in which my dog broke his ankle less hard. So grateful for their kindness.
First time at sploot and had the best experience, super caring and helpful made sure my pet was taken care of!

Dr Korput and her assistant Lexie were amazing today. It was my kitten’s first appointment so they came prepped to make her comfortable and get the job done quick. They were very communicative with what they were doing and why. I left with more information on how to take care of my kitten and will be back.
They always do great with my boy Forrest!!

At first I thought this place was pretty ok until the vet acted like she was scared of my cat and made the assistant get my cat out the carrier instead of trying herself. My cat never left the carrier and I was charged for an exam that was never performed. I had another appointment scheduled for Thursday and when I inquired about the pricing for that appointment since the previous appointment was not able to be physically done, I got a bunch of jargon and excuses and I was not happy. This was my first time and my last . I don’t appreciate not being accommodated but being charged for services NOT RENDERED!

I brought in my sisters cat who hadn’t eaten or drank water in over 24 hours.  I was so scared.  Nurse Indigo and Dr Weinberg were a saving grace.  They explained everything and after treatement, my sisters cat was eating!   She did a 180 health wise.  I thank them so much for their care!
Amazing clinic and people! Took great care of my Ellie and would absolutely recommend to anyone who needs a vet here in Chicago!

The staff is great and always makes us feel welcomed. My dog absolutely loves coming here. However, I am disappointed with their schedule management. I arrived 5 minutes before my appointment and proceeded to wait for 20 minutes before my dog was seen. I understand that they were having a busy morning, but if that’s the case, then a different appointment time should be given at the time of booking.
The nurse and vet were very kind and gentle with my anxious dog.

Made an appointment for the Logan Square location last min because my pup got bit at the dog park. They were extremely friendly and helpful on the phone and accommodated us. Parking behind the building was validated so I didn’t have to stress about parking. The entire staff was kind and helpful and very friendly. My dog gets nervous easily but she was well taken care of- Lexie and Dr. Fluegge were awesome, looked at Ella’s ear and offered to update her vaccinations while at the appt. Every thing was reasonably priced and an overall wonderful experience. We will def be back! Thank you guys!

Dr. Flugge and Lexie took SUCH good care of my baby during her annual physical and routine vaccination appointment. My dog is extremely anxious and aggressive during vet appointments but this team took such good care of my girl and I knew she was in good hands. I plan to see them again the next time we need to go to the vet!

Always an excellent experience at Sploot! Unagi and I have been coming to Sploot since we moved to Chicago, and the care we receive at every visit is excellent. The new location (Sploot Clybourn) is fantastic - all the staff are super friendly, and clearly really care about animals. Super grateful for the care Uni receives at Sploot - thank you 🙂

During our most recent visit, we saw Dr. Korput and Lexie. They were incredibly thorough, patient, and gentle with my pup. Very grateful for the Sploot team!
Excellent service for my dog. Very friendly staff and very good prices.
Dr. Korput and Lexie did a great job keeping my cat calm and comfortable during his visit. 100% will return again.

Our cat, Louis, had some digestive issues and we visited Sploot Lincoln Park clinic last Friday. Everyone was warm and friendly. Our doctor was very attentive and kind. Louis is not an easy patient, but Sploot team took their time not to rush or dismiss him as a difficult cat. All nurses were very patient and understanding. We are grateful for care we received and definitely will be back! Thank you!

Second time coming here and it was another great experience! Everyone was very helpful and transparent especially when it came to cost. Mr. Chow has a swollen/red paw thats has caused him limp around so we came in to make sure he was okay. Dr. Korput and Sandy took great care of him!

Fantastic experience for my little kitten’s first check up! He had an eye infection so they moved our appt up a few days to quickly address it, and also taught us how to trim his nails. Entire staff was welcoming and kind. Special shoutout to Dr. Korpot and Lexie!

I was able to get a same-day appointment to get my cat checked out. The staff was thorough, provided a variety of care options, and offered follow up. It was a great visit. My cat was calm throughout.

I literally cannot recommend this place enough!! I woke up to my dog sick, they had same day actually with in an hour appointment! They dealt with all of my emotions of my 12 year old dog being sick. They were not only comforting to me but mostly my dog. They were thorough for what we all knew was a UTI but went above and beyond in their care without up charging and making me take out a loan for my dogs care. Walked me through next steps as worst case scenario if things don’t improve, how to get cheapest medication for her, and make the whole experience better in my worst day. To make matters even better they texted me the next day checking in on my sweet girl. Definitely have found my new vet/ care team for my dog. They offer a yearly membership I will be looking into!

I’ve been taking my cat here for years. They recently did a tooth extraction for him, and the service was outstanding from beginning to end. Excellent communication at every step of the process, and they were very transparent about estimates, and mine came well within range.

Very thorough about everything before during and after the procedure, and they have been great about following up and checking in.

Nurse K, Sandy and Dr. Cruz were all wonderful to work with and they made a stressful process like your pet having surgery so much easier.
Dr.Cruz & Sandy are the BEST. Attentive, caring, thorough, answered every question & were extremely helpful with everything. I am SO appreciative of the team!

Great service and attention to detail. This comes tons of love and affection for animals while maintaining a clear understanding of how to work with them. I also appreciated the well maintained atmosphere, and convenient location and parking.

Brought my dog in for a split nail, they were able to get him in a cone and some of the nail fixed. The vet gave clear instructions on home care and we were able to schedule a follow up appointment with the same provider. Friendly and quick service.
Very satisfied with the care Newsom received. He is doing well.
I’ve been taking my dog to Sploot for almost a year now and my only regret is not coming here sooner. The staff is always friendly and patient with our nervous dog.

Great Vet. Love the convenient hours and ability to get an appointment quickly. I have the Sploot pack membership and it’s easy to get your moneys worth. Everyone is so friendly and the staff is great.
Dr Chica and Haikey were very attentive, diligent and gentle with my dog, Charlie.  They also fallow up with detail results and recommendations from her blood test

I took my cat for an emergency situation and the staff was so kind! Truly the best experience I’ve had. They got us in ASAP to make sure he was ok and prioritized letting me stay with him to keep his stress down. They were very communicative throughout our visit and transparent about what the treatments would cost. Will be returning for regular vet visits, highly recommend.

Sploot is not our normal vet, but they were able to get my dog in for a same day sick visit on a Sunday when our normal vet was closed. Everyone was so kind, explained everything in detail including expected costs, and took great care of my buddy.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to Sploot who took care of Gatto. From the very first moment, they provided beautiful care full of professionalism, love, and patience. They explained everything clearly and in a way that was easy for us to understand, which made us feel calm and confident throughout the visit.

This was our first time taking Gatto to the veterinarian, and we were worried about how he would react, but he felt very comfortable and safe the entire time. We felt very comfortable during the appointment, and most importantly, Gatto was extremely calm. He was treated with so much love, kindness, patience, and professional care. As pet family, we truly appreciate this level of dedication. It was a wonderful experience, and we highly recommend her.

Thank you so much ❤️
Everyone was friendly, patient, and great at answering all of my questions. Sploot is so convenient and a fantastic option when we can’t get into our normal vet office but don’t need to go to the ER.
Very friendly from the moment we arrived. Paid a lot of attention to Ace and made him feel at ease. Had lick mats to distract him during exam and vaccinations. Highly recommend.
Everyone was so kind & helpful when I brought my new puppy in

It’s become very challenging to get an appointment with the veterinary practice that I’ve taken my dogs to for the past twenty years - so much so that they have started recommending urgent care clinics for injuries, ear infections, etc.  Sploot is right in the neighborhood and staffed by friendly, competent professionals.  They have had appointments readily available and have been able conduct any needed testing (blood tests; ear infection culture) on-site while we waited.  Today they took an x-ray to check for signs of arthritis in my middle-aged dog and dispensed prescriptions as well.  We have been in three times now and have been impressed with the cleanliness of the facility and professionalism of the staff each time. I was happy to see that they also offer vaccinations and other primary care services and will be keeping that in mind going forward.  Thanks to the team there for taking such good care of us!

After going to another vet and the prices got so crazy I was looking for a new vet... So glad that I found this place! I loved that they didn't pressure me into things and could make the right decision for me and my cat. The prices seemed very reasonable compared to what I was paying. Hailey and Dr. Weinberg provided excellent and caring service!!
Osama was the technician who helped me and was very kind and patient with my feisty kitty!
Dr. Choca & Hailey were great. Very friendly, thorough and informative

Simply overpriced to be overpriced. $1500 to get a cat spayed. Yes you read that correct $1500. That $490 for the consultation with blood work and annual shots then $800-$1100 for the actual spay. Meanwhile every other vet is $50 for both shots and $250 for a spay. The only reason I give sploot 2 stars is because the staff is friendly. Beyond that avoid sploot. As predatory as a car dealership they only try to upsell you after charging you already absorbatant prices. Dont be fooled like I was.
Sploot is amazing! We’ve never had a bad experience, my dog is very anxious and they take great care of him. Highly recommend!

The team at Sploot is amazing!! My dog has epilepsy and has seizures whenever I take her to the vet, so it’s a very stressful event for the both of us. The staff at Sploot is so accommodating and kind. They make sure they have a room available so we can walk right in and avoid the waiting area. They also have staff there, ready to take her if an emergency happens. They’re so kind and patient with both me and my dog, I couldn’t ask for a better vet! If you’re looking for a vet that cares about your baby as much as you do, I highly recommend Sploot!
Very grateful for their attention and care for my dog. Also, they were super clear and upfront about all the costs which—as a teacher—I really appreciate.

Very comprehensive and caring urgent care visit for my dog’s ear infection thanks to Kate, Hailey, and Dr. Choca! Thanks for taking such good care of my sick pet and offering lots of context on what was going on. :)
Sploot always does such a great job taking care of our dog. Their staff is so kind and attentive and they always follow up after just to see how she’s doing - love them!

Great vet clinic, pets are the priority and good communication to help pet parent feel at ease. Took my house panthers for a cleaning and extractions and he has been on the mends with the help and support of the team. He left chipper after a recheck.

Follow up on annual, great bill of health and full vaccines given by a good supportive staff.
Absolutely love this vet!! Everyone is so friendly. It’s a very clean and very peaceful environment.
Love Sploot. Always easy to find appointments and staff is very kind. The facilities are clean and bright.
thank you for taking care of my pup. everyone who worked with us was caring and sincere. thank you 🙏🏼

From check-in to check-out, the folks here really did a fantastic job of caring for me and my pup! I felt very secure and confident that my dog was getting top-tier care, the kind of care you’d get if you were among family. Thank yall so much!!

I had an OUTSTANDING experience from start to finish. My cat was in a scary falling from a high up spot and not landing properly. They not only heard me, they genuinely listened to me as a pet parent. I never felt like they were dismissing what I know is my cats regular behavior over the behavior she showed after the accident. The Vet techs treated my baby like a queen and treated us with such kindness/care through the whole experience. I love my cat and being there for a while flew by due to how amazing this whole staff was! Thank you all for making my experience as easy as possible!!!!
This is a wonderful urgent care that always provides wonderful care!

I cannot say enough great things about Sploot! From the moment we walked in, Emily S. at the front desk greeted us with a smile, was incredibly efficient, and even helped us figure out the most cost-effective way to handle our visit.

Nurse Kate D. was exceptional with our usually nervous senior girl—she put her (and us!) completely at ease with her gentle, confident approach.

And then the coup de grâce: Dr. Weinberg. Within 20 minutes of meeting her, we knew she had to be our new vet—no hesitation, despite having gone to our previous place for over 15 years. She was thorough, knowledgeable, never pushy, and never made us feel like she was trying to “upsell” anything. Even though we were the last appointment of the day, she still took the time to see if Gizmo might be tempted by some special treats.  Spoiler alert- she was!

This team is wonderful. We feel truly confident in their care and know they’ll be there for us and our 18-year-old pup without ever making us feel like a bother or a dollar sign.

Run—don’t walk—to this practice!
Very friendly and caring staff.  Received good information and help.
